basic_profile.bio: A 32-year-old graphic designer based in Philadelphia, I'm passionate about digital arts and crafts. My interests span from designing using silhouette cutters to exploring blockchain technology with Flare Networks. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, as a wind-down routine. I enjoy journaling and keeping track of my thoughts through bullet journals. Currently in a long-term relationship with a supportive partner who shares my love for tech and creativity. Not a fan of negativity or misinformation, especially during these challenging times.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in digital design, acquired through a Bachelor's in Graphic Design and several years of experience working with creative software. I've also developed a keen interest in decentralized technologies, self-taught through online courses and community forums.
